entities.title: Bottle archive
entities.summary: The archive brew pours for the zazzle formula: its name, its layout and its checksum in the formula's bottle block.
consumers: Homebrew, when a user runs brew install or brew upgrade on zazzcat/z/zazzle
guarantees: Named zazzle-VERSION.all.bottle.tar.gz (one hyphen), the name Homebrew downloads from a plain root_url

Holds exactly zazzle/VERSION/: bin/ with zazzle, zazzled, afs, fix-network, free-disk-space and the zazzle-csharp-indexer placeholder (mode 0755, owned by 0:0), and libexec/indexer/ with the two gzipped indexers
The placeholder is identical to the one the formula's install writes
Reproducible: the same files give the same archive
The formula's bottle block names the release's download folder as root_url, one sha256 tagged all, with cellar :any_skip_relocation
entities.compatibility: Fixed by Homebrew (Bottle::Filename#url_encode and Bottle#extract_snapshot); a change here breaks brew install.

entities.title: Each binary names itself in its version output
entities.summary: The formula's test block runs zazzle version and --version on the other five binaries, and expects each output to contain the binary's name (agent-fs for afs).
consumers: The formula's test block (brew test zazzle)
guarantees: zazzle version prints zazzle; zazzled, fix-network, free-disk-space and zazzle-csharp-indexer --version print their names; afs --version prints agent-fs
entities.compatibility: Renaming a crate or binary changes what it prints and breaks brew test. formula.test.sh checks that the test block runs these six commands, but its stand-in answers for the binaries, so a mismatch with what they really print is not caught there.
